_note: Managed SCA exception register. All pip entries require: id (GHSA/CVE/PYSEC), owner (GitHub username), expires (ISO 8601 date), justification. Expired entries BLOCK CI — resolve the vulnerability or renew with a new expiry and updated justification.
_npm_note: npm exceptions are managed via .audit-ci.jsonc (https://github.com/IBM/audit-ci). Add advisory IDs to the allowlist array in that file with an inline expiry comment. This register tracks them for governance purposes only.

frontend.justification: react-router CSRF bypass only affects the unstable RSC (React Server Components) APIs; this app is a client-side Vite SPA and does not use RSC mode. No non-breaking fix exists yet: react-router-dom@7.18.1 (latest published) pins react-router to the exact vulnerable 7.18.1 release, and the patched react-router@8.3.0 requires a react-router-dom 8.x release that has not been published. Re-evaluate before expiry and upgrade once react-router-dom ships a compatible release. Allowlisted in frontend/.audit-ci.jsonc.
